chapter: Los Angeles: Roy Milton and Central Avenue
title: Sunday sessions with Hampton Hawes and Wardell Gray
summary: Sunday jam sessions with Hawes, Sonny Criss, Wardell Gray and other session regulars.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: In the meantime, Hampton Hawes, the pianist, he was coming out of high school just about the time that Sonny was coming out of school. So we all would play on Sundays out there. And Wardell Gray had moved out here, and we would play out there... We had some fantastic sessions out there on Sunday. We had a very fine bassist named Clarence Jones, and Chuck Thompson, an excellent drummer, was around here some of the time, and Roy Porter was around here... Oh, they had a lot of great players...
That group really kind of stayed together. Because when I started going to dances just a few years later, in 1949, you were there every Sunday, no matter where the session was...
